design temperature: 19 F is a stand-in (WSEC Table RC-1 Bellingham IAP 19 F / 78 F [S]; MJ8 Table 1A 23 F / 76 F [V] (Sudden Valley is ~8 mi from the airport, 300-700 ft up - STAND-IN on the Bellingham row)) - pull WSEC Table RC-1 for sudden valley before this goes out
hood: A700 kitchen 'Range' - no hood CFM on the sheet; 300 cfm ASSUMED (under the 400 cfm make-up air trigger)
mechanical permit fee: Whatcom County PDS residential mechanical fee schedule - NOT FOUND in the 9/25 research (references/research-hvac-code.md 8): price it from the county sheet

scope: Equipment: design: 19 F heating / 78 F cooling (sudden valley); heating load 18,306 Btuh, cooling 0.97 tons (room-by-room, Manual J method); unit house: 24k ducted heat pump outdoor, 24k air handler in MECHANICAL ROOM UNDER STAIRS, 13 supply registers, 2 returns, 5 kW strip; cold-climate variable-capacity heat pump(s), A2L refrigerant, HSPF2 >= 9.4 per the WSEC credit

Rough-in: line sets 26 ft (concealed), condensate to daylight, communication cable; ductwork 337 ft: trunks, flex branches, boots, returns, transfer paths; ventilation: erv 45.0 cfm continuous (WA M1505.4) - ERV with ducted supply / exhaust; exhaust: every bath fan ducted and capped, dryer vent, range hood duct and cap - 285 ft

Trim, start-up and tests: registers and grilles, first filters, start-up and charge verification, controls set-up; tests: ventilation flow test, duct leakage test, the permit load calculation; inspections: Mechanical rough-in (cover), Duct leakage test, Ventilation flow test, Final mechanical
